candidates.description: A view of the north entrance to the Shanghai South Railway Station.  You can see the circular main building shape, as well as its many floors. On the bottom level there is a line of people waiting for taxis, which are coming frequently, but not enough to meet demand.  In the foreground are artificially sculpted lawns covering what will be and underground mall when completed.
